# Sagara Strategic Legal Advisory

> Boutique law firm in Jakarta, Indonesia (SCBD), founded in 2025 by Indonesian advocate Aulia Guzasiah, S.H., M.H. — licensed by PERADI, and a receiver (kurator) and administrator (pengurus) registered with the Ministry of Law of the Republic of Indonesia and a member of AKPI. Advises creditors, Indonesian businesses and foreign companies on bankruptcy and PKPU, debt recovery, commercial contracts, and commercial disputes. Works in Indonesian and English.

## Services (English)
- [Creditor Representation in PKPU and Bankruptcy](https://sagarastrategic.com/en/pkpu-bankruptcy-creditor-representation/): claim filing and verification, renvoi, composition plans, creditor strategy in PKPU and bankruptcy before the Indonesian Commercial Court
- [Debt Recovery in Indonesia](https://sagarastrategic.com/en/debt-recovery-indonesia/): demand letters, negotiation, small claims, civil lawsuits, PKPU and bankruptcy, enforcement
- [Commercial Contract Review and Drafting](https://sagarastrategic.com/en/commercial-contract-review-indonesia/): review and drafting of commercial agreements, including bilingual contracts and Indonesian language requirements
- [Commercial Disputes and Litigation](https://sagarastrategic.com/en/commercial-litigation-indonesia/): breach of contract and tort claims, shareholder disputes, arbitration, enforcement of arbitral awards
- [Legal Counsel for Foreign Businesses in Indonesia](https://sagarastrategic.com/en/foreign-business-legal-counsel-indonesia/): foreign and foreign-owned (PMA) companies, expatriate (TKA) employment compliance, bilingual employment contracts
